ui_bugs.issue: When a stage drill-down chip is active (e.g. Stage: At Risk from a KPI click) the status dropdown still appears interactive and shows the selected value, but the backend ignores status when stage is present (verified: /api/cases?status=VERIFIED_RECOVERED&stage=at_risk returns the same 778 at-risk cases as stage alone). The UI therefore displays 'Verified Recovered' selected while the table lists ACTION_EXECUTED/APPROVAL_PENDING rows - misleading. Backend must not change, so the UI should clear/disable the stage chip when a status is chosen (or vice-versa) or surface a 'stage overrides status' note.

Duplicate object key: IMPORTED is defined twice (line 36 green, line 41 slate) - ESLint no-dupe-keys error; the later slate entry silently wins, so the intended green IMPORTED style is dead code. Pick one.

issues: KPI card eyebrow labels wrap to 3 lines ('REVENUE CURRENTLY AT RISK', 'VERIFIED NET RECOVERY') because of the wide 0.18em tracking in a narrow 6-column grid, making card heights uneven; consider 5 columns or smaller tracking at >=xl.
100 pending approval cards are rendered as full-size cards with no pagination/virtualisation - long scroll and heavy DOM (page body text ~60k chars).

rca_of_the_issue: Stage/status conflict: GET /api/cases applies the stage filter as an exclusive population selector, so a concurrently sent status param is ignored (proved by three API calls: status only -> 83 VERIFIED_RECOVERED, stage=at_risk -> 778, both -> the same 778). Dashboard.jsx keeps stage and status in the same EMPTY_FILTERS state object and sends both, so after a KPI drill-down the status dropdown looks applied but has no effect. Fix is frontend-only: reset filters.stage when a status is selected (and/or disable the status select while the stage chip is shown).
